extension.description: IntelliSense, inline hints, template previews, task launching, character data tools, and more for ok-script projects.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with ok-script Toolkit
walkthrough.description: Choose what you want to do and follow the project → resources → run workflow.
walkthrough.goal.title: What do you want to do?
walkthrough.project.title: 1. Load an ok-script project
walkthrough.project.description: Open a workspace containing `config.py` or `src/config.py`, or configure `okScriptToolkit.okScriptProjectPath`. This step completes automatically when a supported project is detected.
walkthrough.visual.title: 2. Create visual resources
walkthrough.visual.description: [Open Annotation Management](command:okScriptToolkit.openTemplateAssets) to capture or import images and create Template, Rect, and Point annotations in one editor.
walkthrough.visual.mediaAlt: Image to Template, Rect, and Point annotation and publishing workflow
walkthrough.publish.title: 3. Publish resources
walkthrough.publish.description: [Open Resource Publishing](command:okScriptToolkit.openResourcePublisher), select Template / Rect / Point, then publish. Position resources can be exported as JSON or Python.
walkthrough.run.title: 4. Run and debug
walkthrough.run.description: [Open the runner](command:okScriptToolkit.showTaskLauncher), choose a task, adjust parameters, start it, and follow runtime status and logs.
walkthrough.links.title: Keep exploring

configuration.title: ok-script Lang Hints
config.langDirectory: Language JSON directory relative to the workspace root.
config.poDirectory: gettext PO directory relative to the workspace root, using <locale>/LC_MESSAGES/*.po.
config.enablePoData: Enable gettext PO data for OCR match hints.
config.poDomains: gettext PO domains to load. The default only loads ocr.
config.displayLocale: Default locale for inline hints. auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.enableInlayHints: Enable inline hints for language values and effects.
config.featureAliases: Aliases used for FeatureList template completion and hover.
config.labelEnumPath: LabelEnum.py path relative to the workspace root, with or without the .py suffix. Overrides labelEnum.path in ok-script-toolkit.json; leave empty to follow the project convention.
config.labelEnumName: LabelEnum class name. Overrides labelEnum.name in ok-script-toolkit.json; leave empty to follow the project convention — falling back to the file name only when the project does not declare one. Project code imports this class by name, so renaming it breaks those imports — you will be asked to confirm before an existing file is overwritten.
config.effectsFile: EffectType and EFFECT_DESCRIPTIONS Python file relative to the workspace root.
config.okScriptProjectPath: ok-script project root containing src/config.py. Used by the task launcher.
config.okScriptPython: Python interpreter used to run ok-script tasks. Empty uses the target project's .venv on Windows.
config.captureMethod: Game window capture method. auto tries Windows Graphics Capture and falls back to BitBlt. Use foreground for launcher or login screens that capture blank otherwise: it activates the window and reads the screen, which steals focus.
config.copyCoordsSpace: Add a space after each comma when copying box coordinates (x, y, tox, toy). A personal habit — application scope only, cannot be set per workspace.
config.characterProjectPath: Project root used by the character and skill manager. Empty falls back to okScriptProjectPath and the current workspace.
config.characterMasterFile: Character master JSON relative to the character project root.
config.characterSkillsDirectory: Character skill JSON directory relative to the character project root.
config.characterLocaleFile: Character name localization JSON relative to the character project root.
config.characterAvatarTemplateRegex: Regular expression for avatar template names. The first capture group is used when present; otherwise the text after the matched prefix is compared with the character's English slug. Defaults to battleicon/battle_icon/battle-icon prefixes.
config.okTemplatesDirectory: ok_templates folder name relative to the workspace root. Used by annotation management.
config.annotationKeybindings: Keyboard shortcuts for the unified annotation editor, including template/box/point mode switching. Each value is a key name, optionally prefixed with modifier(s) joined by `+` (e.g. `ctrl+z`, `shift+d`). Supported keys: letters, digits, `Delete`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, etc.
config.positionJsonPath: Project-relative output path for Position JSON publishing. Precedence: your IDE preference → `ok-script-toolkit.json` project convention → built-in default.
config.positionPythonDirectory: Project-relative directory for generated `ScreenRatio.py` and `PositionMap.py`. Precedence: your IDE preference → `ok-script-toolkit.json` project convention → built-in default.
